services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Available from the right edge of Site 6 to the 4th Street Fence. Ideal for traditional tent camping or RVs that do not require hookups. In the event that all main sites at both ChoCoFair and Canoe Launch Campgrounds are full, orderly overflow camping may be permitted in the grassy parking lot located between the Rodeo Grounds and Pimperton Arena. For more information, please contact the Fairgrounds Office. Our property is regularly patrolled by Chouteau County Sheriff Officers to ensure safety and security.
